name: Run Diffdock With Smiles
description: Run DiffDock molecular docking using a protein PDB file and a SMILES string for the ligand, executing the process in a Docker container.
detailed_description: Run DiffDock molecular docking using a protein PDB file and a SMILES string for the ligand, executing the process in a Docker container.
when_to_use: When you need run diffdock with smiles analysis

parameters.pdb_path: [Required] Path to the protein PDB file for docking (str)
parameters.smiles_string: [Required] SMILES string representation of the ligand molecule (str)
parameters.local_output_dir: [Required] Local directory path where docking results will be saved (str)
parameters.gpu_device: [Optional] GPU device ID to use for computation (default: 0)
parameters.use_gpu: [Optional] Whether to use GPU acceleration for docking (default: True)
